name: X-Man Tornado V5 3x3 (Pioneer UV)
description: The X-Man Tornado V5 3x3 (Pioneer) pushes the boundaries of flagship speedcubes, blending next-generation technology with legendary performance. The V5 continues the acclaimed Tornado legacy from QiYi and X-Man Designs, delivering a meticulously refined solving experience for competitive speedcubers and collectors alike.
features: Pioneer Edition features a 20-magnet ball-core (for precise, consistent turn control) and a state-of-the-art MagLev tension adjustment system.
Both editions are finished with an ultra-glossy UV coating for a brilliant, long-lasting shine and enhanced grip.
New dual magnetic positioning and secure spherical core shell ensure magnets stay perfectly positioned for stable, explosive turns.
Engineered for speed and control, with full-bright six-color splits and a visually stunning, scratch-resistant finish.
